calendarNotes: LPS uses two opening dates: kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 attend August 12, while grades 1–5, 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 13. Quarter 1 ends October 10; October 13 is a general no-school day, October 14 is a professional learning/planning day and Quarter 2 begins October 15. Thanksgiving no-school dates run November 26–28, followed by a professional learning/planning day December 1. Quarter 2 ends December 19, Semester Break runs December 22–January 2 and Quarter 3 begins January 5. The February 16–17 closure combines a general no-school day with a professional learning/planning day. Quarter 3 ends March 6, Spring Break runs March 9–13 and Quarter 4 begins March 16. LPS warns that weather-related lost time may change minutes or days when required to meet Nebraska minimum school hours.

customSections.label: How the LPS Two-Day Opening Works
customSections.content: The August 12 symbol applies only to kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9. Those are the entry grades for elementary, middle and high school. Students in grades 1–5, 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 13.

customSections.label: Quarter Breaks Combine Different Kinds of No-School Days
customSections.content: The PDF uses separate symbols for a quarter ending, a general closure, a professional learning/planning day and the next quarter starting. Keeping those labels separate explains why some breaks span several dates without every date having the same purpose.

customSections.label: LPS 2026 Graduation Dates
customSections.content: The Student Calendar lists program ceremonies before the comprehensive high-school weekend. Families should use school communication for times, tickets and ceremony instructions.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Lincoln Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 start Tuesday, August 12, 2025. Grades 1–5, 7–8 and 10–12 start Wednesday, August 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is LPS Semester Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar marks all schools out from December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Quarter 3 starts Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Lincoln Public Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: LPS Spring Break runs Monday, March 9, through Friday, March 13, 2026. Quarter 4 begins Monday, March 16.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the last day of Lincoln Public Schools in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The district Student Calendar marks Thursday, May 21, 2026, as the last day for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Can an LPS no-school day become a student day?
calendarFaqs.a: Potentially. LPS says severe weather or other changes may require added minutes, added calendar days or rescheduling a previously identified non-student day to meet state minimum school hours.
